BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION The Wildfire Challenge & Sensor Noise
CSC3034
Limitations of Conventional Systems
  • Climate Amplification: Megafires are rising in intensity and speed, demanding autonomous aerial detection (UN SDGs 13 & 15).
  • Binary Alarm Failures: Simple thresholds (e.g. T > 40°C) cause false alarms during humid heat and miss hazards during dry, windy conditions.
  • Non-Linear Dynamics: Fire spread is governed by interconnected atmospheric variables: heat, desiccated fuel, and turbulent wind shear.
  • Turbulence & Sensor Noise: Low-cost drone sensors exhibit drift and electromagnetic jitter in harsh forest terrain.
Proposed Soft-Computing Solution
  • Mamdani Fuzzy Logic: Implements continuous, robust reasoning under sensor uncertainty with human-interpretable linguistic rules.
  • Multi-Sensor Fusion: Fuses Ambient Temperature, Relative Humidity, and Wind Speed into a normalized Fire Risk Index (FRI).
  • Closed-Loop Drone Modulation: Automatically throttles UAV flight speed (6.5 to 22.5 m/s) to maximize surveillance dwell time over hotspots.
  • NVIDIA Isaac Sim Twin: Physics-accurate OpenUSD simulation enables safe, zero-risk validation before real-world flight.
METHODOLOGY & WORKFLOW End-to-End Autonomous Surveillance Pipeline
CSC3034
1. Sensing

UAV synthetic thermal and atmospheric probes ingest T, RH, and WS at 60 Hz from Isaac Sim.

2. Fuzzification

Converts crisp telemetry into membership degrees across 4 linguistic sets per input.

3. Inference

27 Mamdani min-max rules compute aggregated fuzzy consequence surfaces.

4. Defuzzification

Centroid calculation produces crisp Fire Risk Index (0-100%) and Patrol Speed (5-25 m/s).

5. Actuation

USD attributes synchronize UAV flight keyframes and dispatch instant ground alerts.

FUZZY ENGINE SPECIFICATION Linguistic Variables & Membership Functions
CSC3034
Universes of Discourse
  • Temperature (T): [0, 50]°C • Low, Moderate, High, Extreme
  • Relative Humidity (RH): [0, 100]% • High, Moderate, Low, Very Low
  • Wind Speed (WS): [0, 80] km/h • Calm, Moderate, High, Severe
  • Fire Risk Index (FRI): [0, 100]% • Safe, Caution, High, Critical
  • Patrol Urgency Speed: [5, 25] m/s • Loiter, Nominal, Fast, Sprint

Design Principle: Trapezoidal functions for boundary domains (e.g. Extreme heat > 45°C) guarantee full saturation, while triangular functions handle transitional regions.

SIMULATION EXPERIMENTS Autonomous Mission Telemetry & Actuation
CSC3034
Observed System Behavior
  • Baseline Transit (Frames 0-100): Ambient temp 24°C, FRI = 12.4% (SAFE). Drone sprints at 22.5 m/s to cover search area.
  • Hotspot 02 Incursion (Frames 200-340): Sensor detects sudden thermal spike to 78.4°C. Fuzzy controller escalates FRI to 92.6% (CRITICAL).
  • Speed Throttling: Urgency speed automatically drops to 6.5 m/s, allowing the UAV to loiter and capture high-resolution imagery.
  • Hotspot 03 Flare-Up (Frames 450-520): Moderate risk (FRI = 64.2%), drone decelerates to 12.0 m/s for confirmation.
COMPUTATIONAL INTELLIGENCE ANALYSIS Defuzzification Comparative Benchmark
CSC3034
Strategy Comparison
Method Avg Latency Actuator Smoothness Noise Robustness
Centroid (COG) 0.884 ms Exceptional (Smooth) High
Bisector 0.912 ms Good Moderate
Mean of Max (MOM) 0.420 ms Poor (Step Discontinuities) Low

Finding: Although MOM computes faster, it produces sudden step-changes when peak membership shifts, which would cause violent motor torque spikes on a real quadrotor. Centroid was selected for flight safety.

Real-Time Edge Feasibility
  • Edge Platform: Target deployment on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (8 GB, 7-15 W power budget).
  • Timing Budget: Fuzzy inference execution (0.884 ms) consumes only 1.7% of the 50 ms UAV flight control deadline (20 Hz loop).
  • Scalability: Capable of evaluating 1,000+ rule inferences per second without throttling CPU flight controllers.
